question: The World Day for ______ Heritage was held on the 27th October 2020 with the theme, 'Your Window to the World'.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Audiovisual.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The** World Day for Audiovisual **Heritage was held on the 27th October 2020 with the theme, 'Your Window to the World'.

 
• It raises global awareness of issues on preserving audiovisual material, such as sound recordings and moving images.
 
• The theme for the year 2020 is Your Window To The World.
 
• The 33rd session of UNESCO’s General Conference adopted a resolution to proclaim 27 October as World Day for Audiovisual Heritage.
